title: An enemy's offer
description: Adar shows Galadriel Morgoth's crown, which once unmade Sauron's body, and asks for her ring to finish the work. She sees the trap too late: Sauron has no army of his own — so he lured Adar's here.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Queen of the Sea
description: Elendil refuses to bend the knee and is sentenced to trial by the abyss. Míriel takes his place and is cast into the sea; the sea-worm lets her go, and the Faithful hail her Queen of the Sea.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: A staff, or his friends
description: Tom leads the Stranger to a grove of dead trees to find his staff — and warns that he must choose between his destiny and Nori, whom a vision shows in the hands of the Dark Wizard. The Stranger chooses his friends.

title: Hunted among the Stoors
description: Nori and Poppy lie low in the canyon while the Dark Wizard's riders search for the halflings who travelled with the Istar.

title: Annatar takes charge
description: While Celebrimbor loses himself in the Nine, Annatar quietly takes over the running of the city — and hands the smith a vial of 'mithril' that is nothing of the kind.

title: The siege of Eregion begins
description: Adar's catapults open fire on Ost-in-Edhil. Inside the forge, wrapped in Annatar's illusion of a quiet morning, Celebrimbor hears nothing.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
